rawContent: Why would a father make fun of @dreamhampton who has put herself in harm’s way to seek justice and long overdue compassion for our forgotten daughters? What’s funny about the suffering of Black girls? As a survivor, I’m hurt and disappointed by my friend @DaveChappelle. #MeToo

@DubAnders @JohnSchaech @dreamhampton @DaveChappelle Wow. So much negativity. I’m not taking it in. I’m focused on healing myself and celebrating a woman doing the hard work to heal others. There are a million opportunities @dreamhampton could have pursued to make money. Bravely making #SurvivingRKelly isn’t one of them. #MeToo
I’m humbled to be included in this powerful series with so many inspiring #SilenceBreakers . Thank you  @katekelton ❤️✊🏼✊🏽✊🏾✊🏻✊🏿 #MeToo

Devastating film. I didn’t expect this to be so difficult to watch, because I don’t know #Weinstein. The power dynamic & culture is so similar to my experience working for Russell Simmons, where I was sexually harassed & raped. #MeToo #Untouchable
